body:
- Faster runtime USB acknowledgements: first-available reads remove the 20 ms short-reply batching delay without changing framing, nonce, offset or SHA-256 validation.
- Reduced host port-enumeration overhead with a 250 ms update-session interval; retained fast cancellation and forced identity checks before and after opening the port and before BEGIN. Host identity-check time is excluded from ACK timeouts.
- Added explicit Manufacturing ENTER/PING/EXIT sessions after device selection, serialized teardown and COM ownership, and heartbeat pause during updates and joystick diagnostics. Unsupported firmware remains usable; no automatic post-update ENTER covers BIOS.
- Application tests passed. One physical runtime transfer completed through END and BIOS with firmware 0.1.383; a subsequent run was cancelled early. Repeat stability is not established.
